scenarios.title: S&P review of France, 27 Nov 2026
scenarios.question: Will S&P Global Ratings lower France's long-term foreign-currency rating below A+ at or before its scheduled review on Friday 27 November 2026?
scenarios.resolution: YES if S&P publishes a downgrade of France (to A or lower) dated on or before 27 Nov 2026. NO if France is still A+ after S&P's 27 Nov publication. An outlook change alone is NO. Sources: S&P research update; AFT ratings table.

event.title: S&P Global sovereign rating review: France

base_rate.reference_class: S&P actions on the six EU sovereigns em-macro tracks (France, Germany, Italy, Spain, UK, Poland) since 2014, when the EU began requiring a published calendar of scheduled sovereign reviews, where the outlook going in was stable.
base_rate.headline: 0 downgrades in 36 recorded S&P actions on a stable outlook (0%)
base_rate.range_note: Recorded affirmations are incomplete. Assuming two scheduled reviews a year for each of the 6 sovereigns since 2014 (156 reviews) gives 0% as a lower bound. Both counts include unscheduled actions; em-macro does not mark which were scheduled.

scenarios.title: France 2027 budget and the Article 47 deadline
scenarios.question: Will France's 2027 budget law (loi de finances pour 2027) be promulgated by 31 December 2026?
scenarios.resolution: YES if a loi de finances pour 2027 is published in the Journal officiel dated on or before 31 Dec 2026, including one enacted by ordinance under Article 47. A special law (loi spéciale) is NO. Source: Légifrance / Journal officiel.

base_rate.reference_class: Every French budget cycle in em-macro's calendar (budget laws for 2006-2026): was the budget law promulgated by 31 December, and did it need Article 49.3 or a special law? The subset since June 2022, when the government lost its majority, is shown separately.

scenarios.title: Brazil 2027: fiscal-framework credibility
scenarios.question: By 31 March 2027, will Brazil keep its 2027 primary-balance target at +0.5% of GDP and the LC 200/2023 spending rule unchanged, with no bill sent to Congress to change either?
scenarios.resolution: YES if, on 31 Mar 2027, the 2027 target in force is +0.5% of GDP, no PLN/PLP changing the target or the LC 200/2023 limits has been sent, and the first bimonthly report (RARDP, ~22 Mar 2027) does not propose one. Sources: LDO 2027, Câmara/Senado bill trackers, Tesouro RARDP.

context: Context, not computed: Brazil cut a primary target it had set for itself in July 2015 (2015 target 1.1% to 0.15% of GDP) and in April 2024 (2025 target 0.5% to 0%, in the PLDO 2025).
base_rate.reason: em-macro records no fiscal-target revisions for Brazil, so there is no computed reference class.

scenarios.title: Mexico midterms, 6 Jun 2027
scenarios.question: Will Morena and its allies (PVEM, PT) hold at least two-thirds of the Chamber of Deputies (334 of 500 seats) after the 6 June 2027 election?
scenarios.resolution: YES if the INE's seat allocation (proportional-representation seats are assigned in August) gives Morena, PVEM and PT together 334 or more seats. Source: INE acuerdo de asignación.

scenarios.title: USMCA annual review, 1 Jul 2027
scenarios.question: At or before the 1 July 2027 joint review, will the United States, Mexico and Canada each confirm in writing that they wish to extend USMCA for a new 16-year term (art. 34.7)?
